report.title: Category filter resets to All when navigating to page 2 with active search query

startingConditions.fact: User is on the Acme Store Products page at URL localhost:3000/demo (app version Acme Store demo v1.4.2)
Category is set to All, Search input is empty, page 1 is active, and text reads Category: All · Showing 1–5 of 30

steps.action: Clicks page 2 in the pagination controls
steps.note: Speaker initially said "Three" before correcting themselves to "sorry, page two".

observedFailure.description: Navigating to page 2 drops the selected Electronics category filter, resets the Category dropdown to All, and displays products from other categories.
observedFailure.evidence: Category dropdown "Electronics", URL "localhost:3000/demo?category=Electronics&q=lamp", status "Category: Electronics · Search: "lamp" · Showing 1–5 of 7" → Category dropdown "All", URL "localhost:3000/demo?q=lamp&page=2", status "Category: All · Search: "lamp" · Showing 6–10 of 11"

unknowns: Expected behaviour is not stated in the recording
Browser version, operating system, and underlying product dataset/backend setup are not shown

checks.detail: 12.0s (exp 13.0s): Navigating to page 2 drops the selected Electronics category filter, resets the Category dropdown to All, and displays products from other categories.
